suite: the map (Map . Classic, the counts, the one selection on four surfaces, the view)
expect_red: [real] no jumper crosses a part's number or name on the map

mutations.contract: A part's name takes the first corner of its box that its jumpers, pins and marks leave clear.
mutations.note: Takes the first corner whatever crosses it: on the real model five jumpers then strike through a number or a name.
mutations.replace: return block; /* mutated: the first corner, crossed or not */
